Accessibility can expose private screen content. ReelsDetox reads Instagram controls and uses Back and screen covers to block Reels. Processing is local; screen content is never saved or sent.
App language: English. Appearance follows your device.
English, Hungarian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese.
Matches Instagram controls. Unsupported languages or versions may affect detection.
This turns off protection and stops screen inspection, time tracking and button covering. To remove Android accessibility access as well, disable ReelsDetox in Android settings.
ReelsDetox works locally. There is no backend, account, internet permission, advertising or analytics SDK. Your settings and usage counters stay in this app’s local storage.

The accessibility service transiently inspects Instagram’s exposed interface to recognize Reels. It does not save screen content or collect messages, credentials, browsing content or account information. It never transmits accessibility content.

Accessibility access enables Back actions, a brief screen cover while leaving a blocked Reels viewer, and an optional cover over a safely located Reels button. Covers prevent taps when blocking applies. ReelsDetox does not change Instagram’s APK or files, require root, or request a separate overlay permission.

You control access. Turn protection off on the dashboard, withdraw consent in Settings, or disable the service in Android settings. Clear the app’s storage or uninstall it to remove locally stored settings and counters. ReelsDetox never prevents disabling or uninstalling it.
ReelsDetox is an open-source digital wellbeing app for limiting Instagram Reels. It is not an accessibility aid for disabilities.
Licensed under the MIT License. Source code, installation instructions, testing guidance and known limitations are provided with this project.
ReelsDetox is independent of Instagram and Meta. Instagram is a trademark of its respective owner.

Detection matches exposed Instagram controls. Control labels cover English, Hungarian, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese. Other languages, Instagram versions and interface changes may affect detection. Uncertain screens are left alone; compatibility requires testing on your device.

Recognizes Instagram Reels, applies your chosen blocking or daily time limit, and optionally covers the Reels navigation button. Screen content stays on your device and is not stored. Enable only after reviewing and accepting the in-app disclosure.
Settings or usage could not be read or saved, so protection is paused. Restart the accessibility service and check free storage. Your allowance has not been reset.
